tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search printable products. Returns a reference, name and size per product.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details of one product: options (size, colour, paper, frame), quantities and dimensions.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Create a new design with our image model, fitted to the product (aspect ratio, transparent background for clothing). Takes about 45 seconds.

tools.name: edit_design
tools.description: Change a design or the user's own photo in plain words: add a short text, a name or a date, add a frame, change colours or remove something. Only that change is made. Creates a new design; the original is kept. Takes about 45 seconds.

tools.name: restyle_design
tools.description: Redraws a design or the user's own photo in an illustration style, keeping people and animals recognisable and their colours the same. Creates a new design; the original is kept. Takes about 45 seconds.

tools.name: show_examples
tools.description: Shows example pictures for inspiration: what can go on a product for an occasion or theme (for example 'birthday mug for grandma', 'holiday photo', 'cat'). Existing pictures only; nothing is created.

tools.name: use_example
tools.description: Puts a ready-made design from show_examples (an id starting with bib-) on the user's order: returns a design id for create_proof. Nothing new is created.

tools.name: create_plan
tools.description: Saves the agreed gift idea as a plan: the product, what goes on it, the style and any text, and whether the user's own photo is used. Returns a link to the MyImage2Life website, where the user makes the design, sees the proof and price, and orders. Nothing is created or charged by this tool.

tools.name: get_upload_link
tools.description: Returns a secure link (valid 24 hours) where the user uploads their own photo, drawing or design from their device.

tools.name: get_upload
tools.description: Checks whether the user uploaded a file through the upload link; returns the design id when it is there.

tools.name: use_chat_image
tools.description: Use an image the user put in the chat as the design.

tools.name: create_proof
tools.description: Makes the print-ready files and a mockup that shows exactly what will be printed. Returns a proof id.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Price including shipping and VAT for the delivery country. This is exactly what the user pays.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Creates an unpaid order for an approved proof and returns the link to the checkout page on myimage2life.com (Stripe). Nothing is printed before payment.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status and tracking of an order.
